observations: Two photos show multiple Toyota-style engine assemblies laid on a rack/shelf (looks like used engine units, not a single complete car).
Engines appear to be 2GR/2AR-family V6 layouts (V6 cylinder bank arrangement visible), with accessory pulleys and timing/chain area visible.
Yellow tag papers are placed on some units; text on the tags is not readable enough to confirm engine code.
No clear readable engine model/serial plate, no VIN, and no visible mileage/condition markings.
Some units show oil filter/coolant/oil-related components, but there is no clear proof of running condition.

claims.claim: First grades tokumbo/foreign used 2ar v4 and 2gr v6 engines
claims.evidence: Photos show V6-type engine assemblies, but engine codes (2AR/2GR) are not readable on any plate/label; yellow tags are not legible.
No clear photo of a transmission label/connector pin count; only engine assemblies are clearly visible.

risks.risk: Engine code may be different from what the seller claims (2AR vs 2GR), which changes compatibility and market value.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the engine identification plate/engine code stamping (on the block/head) for each unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-value plausible option among the shown units (treat as unknown used engines with no confirmed code).

risks.risk: Condition may be non-running/unknown (missing parts, internal damage, or incomplete assemblies). Photos only show static parts.
risks.proof: Video clip of a start/test run (or compression/leak-down report) plus a photo of all included components (starter, alternator, ECU/loom if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/possibly not working (worst case for used engines).

risks.risk: Transmission claim (22 pins) may be wrong or not included.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the transmission model/label and the connector/pin count area (or a close-up of the harness connector).
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming the claimed transmission spec is correct (worst case: transmission not included or not matching).

risks.risk: Mismatch between the number of engines shown and what the buyer will receive (seller may be advertising multiple units).
risks.proof: A numbered inventory photo showing exactly which unit(s) correspond to the listing, with matching tags/labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price for the worst-case quantity/selection uncertainty (assume buyer receives only one unit and condition is unverified).

proof_requests: Close-up, readable engine code/serial plate for each unit (photo of stamped code on block/head).
Video of start/test run (or at least a compression test sheet) for the specific unit being sold.
Photos of the transmission (if included): label/model and connector close-up showing pin count (22 pins) clearly.
A photo showing the exact unit(s) for sale with clear identifiers (so buyer knows which one matches the claim).
response.reason: The photos show used V6-type engine assemblies, but the key pricing drivers (exact engine code, whether it runs, and whether the claimed 22-pin auto transmission is included and correct) are not verifiable from the images provided.
